name: Anatomically Constrained Tractography using precomputed 5tt & CSD - No DWI & T1w input
summary: Runs MRtrix3 anatomically constrained tractography (ACT) from precomputed CSD fibre orientation distributions and a precomputed 5-tissue-type mask, without DWI or T1w inputs, and outputs a whole-brain .tck tractogram.
description:
Runs mrtrix3 ACT (Anatomically Constrained Tractography) using either single- or multi-shell diffusion-weighted MRI data. Clone of https://doi.org/10.25663/bl.app.101 (written by Brent McPherson) that requires csd input and allows for 5tt probability mask and brainmask inputs. 

This app is a modification of other apps that do not require a  DWI and T1w input. Because of this, tensor fits and tensor tracking is not possible within this app. The CSD and 5tt masks MUST be pregenerated before running this app.

inputs.description: The path to the  5tt probability mask generated using the Tissue-type Segmentation app.
The path to the CSD datatype files

outputs.description: The whole-brain tractogram, formatted as a .tck file
